projects.name: AI Knowledge Assistant
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented generation system that answers questions using relevant document context.
projects.overview: Ingests PDFs and Markdown files, splits them into chunks, embeds them into a FAISS index, and answers questions with a Gemini model using the retrieved passages as context. Answers cite the source chunks they relied on.
features: Document ingestion for PDF and Markdown
Semantic retrieval over a local FAISS index

updates.summary: Added semantic retrieval so answers draw on the most relevant document chunks instead of keyword matches.
Responses now list the source passages they were based on.
Initial ingestion pipeline for PDF and Markdown files.

projects.name: Surface Defect Detector
projects.description: A convolutional model that flags scratches and dents in photos of machined parts.
projects.overview: Trains a small CNN on a labeled image set of metal parts and serves predictions through a command-line tool. Includes an evaluation script that reports precision and recall per defect class.
features: Batch inference over a folder of images

updates.summary: Batched inference cut folder scan time by running images through the model together.
Fixed an off-by-one in the evaluation script that skewed recall for the smallest class.

projects.name: Tiny KV Store
projects.description: A log-structured key-value store with compaction, written for a databases course.
projects.overview: Appends writes to a log file, keeps an in-memory index of key offsets, and periodically compacts old segments. Built to understand how storage engines trade write speed against read cost.
features: Crash recovery by replaying the log

updates.summary: Added segment compaction to reclaim space from overwritten and deleted keys.

projects.name: Invoice API
projects.description: A REST API for creating and tracking invoices, with PDF export and role-based access.
projects.overview: A FastAPI service backed by PostgreSQL. Supports creating invoices, recording payments, exporting PDFs, and restricting actions by user role.

updates.summary: Added tests covering payment edge cases such as partial and duplicate payments.
Invoices can now be exported as PDF.
